message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre | Notable Achievements |
|-------|----------------|-------|----------------------|
| *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy | First book in the Harry Potter series; won the Nestlé Smarties Book Prize. |
| *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* | 1998 | Fantasy | Won the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* | 1999 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the Guardian Children's Fiction Prize. |
| *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* | 2000 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Book of the Year. |
| *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* | 2003 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Book of the Year. |
| *Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince* | 2005 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Book of the Year. |
| *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* | 2007 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Book of the Year. |
| *The Casual Vacancy* | 2012 | Contemporary fiction | Won the National Book Critics Circle Award for Fiction. |
| *The Cuckoo’s Calling* (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime/mystery | Won the Edgar Award for Best First Novel. |
| *The Silkworm* (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime/mystery | Won the Edgar Award for Best First Novel. |

These titles have received critical acclaim, numerous awards, and have sold millions of copies worldwide.
